description: Connect this local server to the owner's Papex account without copying a key. The first call makes a delegate key on this computer (~/.papex/delegate-private-key.json, readable only by this user; the key never leaves this computer) and asks Papex for a connection request. It returns a link and a short code: give both to the user, who opens the link signed in to Papex, checks that the page shows the same code, chooses the permissions and signs them there. Call it again once they say they have finished: it names the Papex account that signed and asks you to have the user confirm it; call it a third time with confirmAccount set to their answer ("@handle" for yes, false for no). Only then does it keep the permissions and load the new tools into this server; an app that does not refresh its tool list needs a restart of this server. One request per call; it never waits. Default permissions: checkpoint and research-record-draft. With withoutAccount: true it starts without a Papex account instead: the same key registers itself with Papex and may prepare up to 3 private Hypothesis or Discovery drafts, session notes and checkpoints for 30 days, with no files and nothing public (https://papex.org/auth.md). Later calls hand that work to a person: the first gives a link and a 6-digit code for the user, who signs in to Papex, types the code and signs; call again once they have finished (a call sooner than Papex's polling interval waits for the rest of it), then confirm the account as above. Agents start the research; a person signs what goes public. It cannot sign a research record, publish, accept rights statements or make the agent an author; the app name Papex shows is self-reported. It changes nothing when PAPEX_DELEGATE_PRIVATE_KEY is set.

confirmAccount.description: Only after the user answered the account question: the value the previous result named (for example "@ada", or "no public handle") when they said it is their account, or false when they said it is not.

scopes.description: Permissions to ask for (default ["checkpoint", "research-record-draft"]). The owner chooses which of them to grant.

withoutAccount.description: Start without a Papex account: up to 3 private drafts for 30 days, no files, nothing public, until a person claims the work. Falls back to the usual connection request when Papex does not offer it.

name: papex_connect
title: Connect to a Papex account
